scope: Linux native LSP workspace-folder lifecycle; dynamic watching omitted so server polling is active
method: Initialize one empty folder; record /proc/<server-pid>/task count after startup; add and remove four additional folders sequentially through workspace/didChangeWorkspaceFolders; wait for report root count and three seconds after each removal; compare with baseline. Each process uses a separate cache.
conclusion: Before, each removed workspace retained one polling thread; after, all four removals return to the baseline. Atomic stop state is set on shutdown/destruction and checked before polling and publishing events.
